lines.original: Everytime I close my eyes
lines.translation: 每次我闭起双眼

lines.original: 그날이 생각날 때면
lines.translation: 每次回想起那天

lines.original: Everytime I close my eyes
lines.translation: 每次我闭起双眼

lines.original: 다시 또 설레이곤해
lines.translation: 就会再次悸动

lines.original: 언제나 내 맘속에 그날의 그 순간들은
lines.translation: 不管什么时候那天的那个瞬间

lines.original: 여전히 내 맘속에 고스란히 기억될
lines.translation: 依然留在我的心中

lines.original: The best scene of my life more than anything
lines.translation: 比生命中任何场景都要记忆犹新

lines.original: The day before last christmas and gently flowing melodies
lines.translation: 去年圣诞节的前一天 缓缓流淌的旋律

lines.original: In the soft light of candles is where I sang my song for you
lines.translation: 在蜡烛柔和的光里就是我给你唱歌的地方

lines.original: And in your eyes, in your face, in the way you hold my hand
lines.translation: 你的眼睛里 你的脸上 你牵起的我的手

lines.original: The memories of you with me I'll never forget
lines.translation: 从不曾忘记的彼此间的回忆

lines.original: 밤새 고민하고 썼던 그 편지를 읽어가며
lines.translation: 读着苦恼了整晚写出来的信

lines.original: 너무나 떨렸던 그 순간들 까지도
